description: This file implements multiple IPC (Inter-Process Communication) remote service demo threads using Zephyr RTOS, including endpoint registration, message handling, and thread creation for different IPC instances and endpoints.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback when endpoint 0A is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback when data is received on endpoint 0A, stores data and signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0A_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 0 endpoint A, opens service, registers endpoint, and sends messages.

methods.name: ipc0B_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback when endpoint 0B is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0B_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback when data is received on endpoint 0B, stores data and signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0B_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 0 endpoint B, opens service, registers endpoint, and sends messages.

methods.name: ipc1_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback when IPC instance 1 endpoint is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc1_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback when data is received on IPC instance 1, holds RX buffer, updates shared data, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc1_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 1, manages message exchange with nocopy capability.
